method.prominence: Measure peak log power within 5 Hz of each predicted location. Compare with the median bins 20 to 60 Hz to either side. Use a Hann FFT in four nonoverlapping 200 ms blocks.
method.contrasts: Use the second-smallest prominence across the four blocks. Subtract the largest of zero and the 75th percentile prominence from up to four adjacent blocks on either available side. The paired rule uses the weaker of the two strongest contrasts on one frequency pattern.
method.level_floor: Skip a block below -60 dBFS RMS. Skip frequency-specific readings when the peak is below -75 dBFS on the Hann amplitude scale. Require every interior block to meet the level constraints, and at least three exterior blocks of literal source context.
method.point: Same development genuine source-group and isolated-background rule as the shared Mel comparison. Freeze a separate point per arm. Keep existing flags in the supplement arm.
method.advancement: At least two added correct locations across two generator families, at most one added genuine source group in each held panel, and no added isolated background flag. Use 50% truth coverage and 0.30 time IoU. Keep same-word resynthesis separate.
